name: filter-dropdown
title: Filter Dropdown
description: A composable multi-select filter dropdown with category navigation, checkbox options, search, select all, and apply button. Uses namespace exports: FilterDropdown.Root, FilterDropdown.Trigger, FilterDropdown.Content, FilterDropdown.Header, FilterDropdown.Search, FilterDropdown.SelectAll, FilterDropdown.Group, FilterDropdown.Item, FilterDropdown.CategoryList, FilterDropdown.CategoryItem, FilterDropdown.Apply.

docs.lead: A composable multi-select filter dropdown with two-level category navigation, checkbox options, optional search, select all, and an apply button. Designed for maximum flexibility — use it as a flat filter or with drill-down categories.
docs.usage:
import * as FilterDropdown from "@/components/ui/filter-dropdown"

<FilterDropdown.Root>
  <FilterDropdown.Trigger asChild>
    <button>Filters</button>
  </FilterDropdown.Trigger>
  <FilterDropdown.Content>
    <FilterDropdown.Header onBack={handleBack} onReset={handleReset} />
    <FilterDropdown.SelectAll checked={allChecked} onCheckedChange={handleSelectAll} />
    <FilterDropdown.Group>
      <FilterDropdown.Item checked={true} onCheckedChange={handleChange}>Option</FilterDropdown.Item>
    </FilterDropdown.Group>
    <FilterDropdown.Apply onClick={handleApply} />
  </FilterDropdown.Content>
</FilterDropdown.Root>

examples.title: Category Menu
examples.description: A compact category selector with icons. Click a category to drill into its options.
examples.code:
<FilterDropdown.Root>
  <FilterDropdown.Trigger asChild>
    <Button.Root variant="neutral" mode="stroke">
      <Button.Icon as={RiFilterLine} />
      Filters
    </Button.Root>
  </FilterDropdown.Trigger>
  <FilterDropdown.Content className="w-[224px]">
    <FilterDropdown.CategoryList>
      <FilterDropdown.CategoryItem icon={RiPuzzle2Line}>Types</FilterDropdown.CategoryItem>
      <FilterDropdown.CategoryItem icon={RiEyeLine}>Visibility</FilterDropdown.CategoryItem>
    </FilterDropdown.CategoryList>
  </FilterDropdown.Content>
</FilterDropdown.Root>

examples.title: Text Options
examples.description: Multi-select filter with plain text options, select all, and apply button.
examples.code:
<FilterDropdown.Content>
  <FilterDropdown.Header onBack={handleBack} onReset={reset} />
  <FilterDropdown.SelectAll checked={allChecked} onCheckedChange={selectAll} />
  <FilterDropdown.Group>
    <FilterDropdown.Item checked={selected.has('Grant')} onCheckedChange={() => toggle('Grant')}>Grant</FilterDropdown.Item>
  </FilterDropdown.Group>
  <FilterDropdown.Apply onClick={handleApply} />
</FilterDropdown.Content>

examples.title: Badge Options
examples.description: Filter options rendered as badges (e.g., deadline status with colored indicators).

examples.title: Status Badge Options
examples.description: Filter options rendered as status badges for publication status filtering.

examples.title: With Search
examples.description: Filter with a search input for large option lists (e.g., people/users).
examples.code:
<FilterDropdown.Content>
  <FilterDropdown.Header onBack={handleBack} onReset={reset} />
  <FilterDropdown.Search value={search} onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)} />
  <FilterDropdown.SelectAll checked={allChecked} onCheckedChange={selectAll} />
  <FilterDropdown.Group>
    {filtered.map((person) => (
      <FilterDropdown.Item key={person} checked={selected.has(person)} onCheckedChange={() => toggle(person)}>
        <Avatar /> {person}
      </FilterDropdown.Item>
    ))}
  </FilterDropdown.Group>
  <FilterDropdown.Apply onClick={handleApply} />
</FilterDropdown.Content>

examples.title: Two-Level Navigation
examples.description: Complete example with category menu that drills into option panels. Navigation state is managed by the consumer.

examples.title: Flat Filter
examples.description: Single-level filter without category navigation — just options, select all, and apply.
examples.code:
<FilterDropdown.Content>
  <FilterDropdown.Header onReset={reset} />
  <FilterDropdown.SelectAll checked={allChecked} onCheckedChange={selectAll} />
  <FilterDropdown.Group>
    <FilterDropdown.Item checked={true} onCheckedChange={handleChange}>Visible for members</FilterDropdown.Item>
    <FilterDropdown.Item checked={false} onCheckedChange={handleChange}>Hidden from members</FilterDropdown.Item>
  </FilterDropdown.Group>
  <FilterDropdown.Apply onClick={handleApply} />
</FilterDropdown.Content>

examples.title: Composed (Two-Level)
examples.description: The Composed shorthand renders a full two-level filter dropdown from a config array. When 2+ filters are provided, a category menu is shown first.
examples.code:
<FilterDropdown.Composed
  filters={[
    { key: 'types', label: 'Types', icon: RiPuzzle2Line, options: [{ value: 'grant', label: 'Grant' }, { value: 'loan', label: 'Loan' }] },
    { key: 'visibility', label: 'Visibility', icon: RiEyeLine, options: [{ value: 'visible', label: 'Visible' }, { value: 'hidden', label: 'Hidden' }] },
  ]}
  selected={{ types: [], visibility: [] }}
  onSelectedChange={(key, values) => setSelected(prev => ({ ...prev, [key]: values }))}
  onApply={(sel) => console.log(sel)}
>
  <Button.Root>Filters</Button.Root>
</FilterDropdown.Composed>

examples.title: Composed (Flat)
examples.description: When a single filter is provided, the Composed variant skips the category menu and renders options directly.
examples.code:
<FilterDropdown.Composed
  filters={[
    { key: 'visibility', label: 'Visibility', options: [{ value: 'visible', label: 'Visible' }, { value: 'hidden', label: 'Hidden' }] },
  ]}
  selected={{ visibility: [] }}
  onSelectedChange={(key, values) => setSelected(prev => ({ ...prev, [key]: values }))}
  onApply={(sel) => console.log(sel)}
>
  <Button.Root>Visibility</Button.Root>
</FilterDropdown.Composed>

examples.title: Composed with Search
examples.description: Composed variant with searchable enabled for large option lists.
examples.code:
<FilterDropdown.Composed
  filters={[
    { key: 'people', label: 'Created by', icon: RiUserLine, searchable: true, searchPlaceholder: 'Search people...', options: people.map(p => ({ value: p, label: p })) },
  ]}
  selected={{ people: [] }}
  onSelectedChange={(key, values) => setSelected(prev => ({ ...prev, [key]: values }))}
  onApply={(sel) => console.log(sel)}
>
  <Button.Root>Created by</Button.Root>
</FilterDropdown.Composed>

examples.title: Composed with Badges
examples.description: Composed variant where option labels are ReactNode (Badge components) instead of plain strings.
examples.code:
<FilterDropdown.Composed
  filters={[{
    key: 'deadline',
    label: 'Deadline status',
    options: [
      { value: 'Open', label: <Badge.Root variant="light" color="green" size="small">Open</Badge.Root> },
      { value: 'Closed', label: <Badge.Root variant="light" color="red" size="small">Closed</Badge.Root> },
    ],
  }]}
  selected={{ deadline: [] }}
  onSelectedChange={(key, values) => setSelected(prev => ({ ...prev, [key]: values }))}
  onApply={(sel) => console.log(sel)}
>
  <Button.Root>Deadline status</Button.Root>
</FilterDropdown.Composed>

api.name: FilterDropdown.Root
api.description: The root container. Wraps Radix Popover.Root.

api.name: FilterDropdown.Trigger
api.description: The element that opens the filter dropdown.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as child element using Radix Slot

api.name: FilterDropdown.Content
api.description: The dropdown content panel with border, shadow, and animations.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Distance in pixels from the trigger

api.name: FilterDropdown.Header
api.description: Navigation header with Back and Reset filter buttons.

props.name: onBack
props.description: Callback for Back button. If omitted, Back button is hidden.

props.name: onReset
props.description: Callback for Reset filter button. If omitted, Reset button is hidden.

props.name: backLabel
props.description: Custom label for the back button

props.name: resetLabel
props.description: Custom label for the reset button

api.name: FilterDropdown.Search
api.description: A search input with magnifying glass icon for filtering options.

api.name: FilterDropdown.SelectAll
api.description: Checkbox with 'Select all' label and a divider below. Supports indeterminate state.

api.name: FilterDropdown.Group
api.description: Scrollable container for filter items with a custom scrollbar.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Maximum height in pixels before scrolling

api.name: FilterDropdown.Item
api.description: A selectable filter option with a checkbox. Accepts children for flexible content (text, badges, avatars).

props.name: children
props.description: Item content — plain text, Badge, StatusBadge, Avatar + name, or any custom content

api.name: FilterDropdown.ItemIcon
api.description: Polymorphic icon for use inside Item children.

api.name: FilterDropdown.CategoryList
api.description: Container for category items in the category menu view.

api.name: FilterDropdown.CategoryItem
api.description: A non-checkbox item with an icon for category navigation.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Callback when the category is clicked

api.name: FilterDropdown.Apply
api.description: Full-width apply button at the bottom of the filter panel.

api.name: FilterDropdown.Composed
api.description: A composed shorthand that renders a complete filter dropdown from a config array. Automatically handles two-level category navigation (2+ filters) or flat single-level (1 filter). Manages internal view state, search, select all, and reset.

props.name: children
props.description: The trigger element. Rendered via asChild.

props.name: filters
props.description: Filter configuration array. Each entry has key, label, icon, searchable, searchPlaceholder, and options (value + label). 1 entry = flat filter (no categories), 2+ = two-level navigation.

props.name: selected
props.description: Selected values per filter key, e.g. { types: ['grant'], visibility: [] }.

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.description: Called when selection changes for a filter key.

props.name: onApply
props.description: Called when Apply is clicked. Receives all current selections.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Distance in pixels from the trigger

props.name: contentClassName
props.description: Additional className for the content panel

props.name: applyLabel
props.description: Custom label for the apply button
